notes.title: Acclaim is publishing Pixel Washer!
notes.notes: [p]🔥 BIG NEWS! 🔥[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2572060/Pixel_Washer/"]Pixel Washer[/url] is being published by [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45592194"]Acclaim[/url]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562107/f49927be8d0eda3e53e5434f46572db6260ee877.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As a small indie game developer, I'm so happy to have the support of the Acclaim team. With their help, I'll be able to make Pixel Washer bigger and better than I ever could on my own. This is a big step up for me and I'm grateful to be included in their exciting lineup of indie games. Let's goooo![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading and for your support. If you'd like to read more, see [url="https://www.valadria.com/acclaim-pixel-washer/"]my recent newsletter[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562107/75680e14c59a77494b6415e1634672fe851322a6.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned, there's MUCH more to come! 🐷🫧[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]-Matt[/p]
